'''Celestra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Republic Corps of Engineers/Legends|Republic Corps of Engineers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where she fought against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].<ref name="Generator Problems" />

==Biography==
Celestra was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war she served in the [[Republic Corps of Engineers/Legends|Republic Corps of Engineers]], a branch of the army of the army specialized in mechanical maintenance, and was deployed on the Republic held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGPM" /> While stationed on the planet she and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]<ref name="Generator Problems" />

While on Ord Mantell, Celestra was stationed in the Republic stronghold of [[Fort Garnik]] with her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion, [[S3-E3]]. The duo along with several other [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] were sent to repair one of Garnik's external power generators which had been sabotaged by Separatists. The team however was attacked by Separatists and all but Celestra and S3-E3 were killed, with the latter fleeing in to the [[Avilatan Badlands]] and the engineer defending the generator. Attempting to fix the generator she found she could manually keep it steady as long as she was present preventing power loss in Garnik, however to permanently fix it she required tools scattered in the attack and collected by the Separatist soldiers.<ref name="Generator Problems" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Celestra was then approached by a passing [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad|Havoc squad]] and a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] who had been sent to find her by S3-E3. She at first was angry at the pair for arriving too late to save her colleagues but then calmed and asked for their aid in recollecting her lost tools from the separatists. The pair then attacked separatists in the area and recovered from them the tools that Celestra had asked for, a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|Hydrospanner]], a [[Turbohammer]] and a [[Multi-tool/Legends|multitool]], along with five canisters of liquid coolant. Using the equipment she successfully repaired the generator and thanked the heroes for their help, rewarding the smuggler with [[rugged smuggling bracers]] and the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] with [[Republic trooper's vambraces]] as well as 75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.<ref name="Generator Problems" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
While on the mission to repair the generator. Celestra wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]] shirt over a wrapping of the same color along with red pants. She wore a series of straps and belts across her torso and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] which she kept holstered on her right hip.<ref name="Generator Problems" />

==Behind the scenes==
Celestra is a Non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She is involved in a single quest, 'Generator Problems', available to players of the [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] or [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It is not possible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with Celestra as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="Generator Problems" />
